Adriana Rosario   IT Manager Milwaukee, WI • itmanager@gmail.com • +1 414-555-0182
PROFILE SUMMARY
IT Manager with 13 years of experience leading IT operations in Fortune-500 financial services across financial services, 
healthcare, and regulated enterprise IT, specializing in IT strategy, service delivery leadership, and budget ownership, 
currently leading 14 IT staff.
Solid technical and operational foundation across service management (ITIL 4, Agile-ITSM hybrid), collaboration 
(Microsoft 365), identity (Entra ID), ticketing (ServiceNow), and security and compliance (SOC 2 Type II), with strong 
fundamentals in service-management discipline, budget ownership, and business-partnership instincts.
Deep expertise in IT strategy and roadmap ownership, service delivery against SLAs, budget and vendor management, and 
security and compliance oversight, applying practices such as ITIL-aligned change management and executive business 
reviews to deliver reliable, secure, and business-aligned IT operations.
Engaged business partner working cross-functionally with Finance, Security, HR, and business-unit leadership in ITIL-
driven IT organizations, contributing to executive steering committees, quarterly business reviews, and audit readiness 
forums with a pragmatic, outcome-first mindset.
Service-oriented leader who fosters a culture of service ownership and written-decision rigor while owning a $5.4M annual 
IT budget and leading weekly IT leadership review sessions plus IT all-hands and career-development cycles.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Frameworks & Methodologies: ITIL 4, ITSM, COBIT, ISO 20000, Agile-ITSM hybrid, change management, problem 
management, service request management
Collaboration & Identity: Microsoft 365 (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive), Google Workspace, Active 
Directory, Entra ID, Okta, SCIM, conditional access
Infrastructure & Cloud: Windows Server, Linux server administration oversight, VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, Azure, 
AWS, GCP , Intune for endpoints, Jamf for macOS
Service Management Tools: ServiceNow (ITSM, Change, Problem, CMDB), Jira Service Management, Freshservice, 
Zendesk, SLA design, KPI dashboards
Security & Compliance: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, NIST CSF, access reviews, patch management 
oversight, vendor risk assessments, audit readiness
Budget & Vendor Management: Capex/opex budgeting, forecasting, contract negotiation, MSP management, license 
management, RFP/RFI, cloud cost optimization, TCO modeling
Leadership & People 
Management:
Performance management, 1:1 cadence, career-development planning, hiring loops, IT org 
design, cross-functional partnership, executive communication
Project, BC & DR: PMP-aware program leadership, M&A IT integration, ERP/SaaS rollouts, BCDR planning, RTO/
RPO design, tabletop exercises, post-incident reviews
EDUCATION
University of Wisconsin-Madison   B.B.A. in Management Information 
Systems
Madison, WI • Sep 2009 - May 
2013
WORK EXPERIENCE
Northwestern Mutual   IT Manager Milwaukee, WI • Jul 2020 - Present
Lead IT operations for a Fortune-100 financial-services regional hub, managing 14 IT staff across 4 functions (helpdesk 
and end-user support, systems and network administration, and identity and collaboration platforms) for 4,500 internal 
users across the HQ campus plus 9 regional offices.
Authored a 3-year IT roadmap covering M365 modernization, an Entra ID migration from on-prem AD, and ServiceNow 
rollout, securing executive sponsorship and delivering 2 of 3 roadmap phases on time and on budget.
Run IT operations against ITIL 4 SLAs on ServiceNow, sustaining 96% P1 resolution within 4 hours across 28,000 tickets 
per year and maintaining 91% CSAT on quarterly service surveys.
Manage an annual IT budget of $5.4M across capex and opex, negotiating 3 MSP and licensing cycles that saved $720k/
year while expanding coverage for hybrid endpoints.
Partner with the CISO on access controls, patch cadence, endpoint security, and audit readiness for SOC 2 Type II and 
NAIC cybersecurity examinations, clearing 2 back-to-back audits with zero IT findings.
Sponsored 7 cross-functional IT projects including a regional office buildout, an ERP module rollout, and an M&A IT 
integration for a 200-person acquisition, delivering the integration cutover on schedule with zero P1 incidents.
Primary IT point of contact for 8 business units and the regional VP forum, running quarterly IT business reviews and 
standing leadership 1:1s, with the CFO signing off on all 3 IT budget cycles under my tenure.
Aurora Health Care   IT Manager Milwaukee, WI • Jul 2015 - Jun 2020
Owned business continuity and disaster recovery for the regional medical group, including a warm-standby DR site and a 4 
hours RTO / 1 hour RPO standard across clinical applications, with quarterly failover tests all passing.
Authored or updated 22 IT policies covering acceptable use, BYOD, access, change management, and incident response, 
adopted as the regional IT standard and referenced in 2 annual HIPAA audits.
Hired 11 IT staff across helpdesk, sysadmin, and network roles over 4 years, mentored 4 promotions to senior IT roles, and 
sustained 91% retention across the team.
Worked closely with Clinical Operations, Finance, HR, and Compliance teams across 14 clinic sites, authoring 28 SOPs and 
runbooks that shaped the regional operating baseline and onboarding 9 new-hire IT engineers.
